params.body:
On People, the picked option of a choice (Member or Admin, a plan, a trial) was black with white text, the same look as **Send the invitation** next to it. A choice and an action read as the same kind of thing.

- **Choices:** the picked option now has a tinted fill, a dark outline, bold text and a tick. The others stay light. They are radios to assistive tech.
- **Invitation form:** it opens on its own labelled line: Invite to the team, name, email, "as" Member or Admin, then the button.

Checked: build, e2e 28 passing.
params.title: People: a picked option looks picked, not like a button
